correctness.rationale: A complete-return border cannot contain all three ones. Classifying zero-, one-, and two-one privileged borders gives a rigorous disjoint exhaustive family; the converse constructs two-occurrence privileged borders. Exact geometric summation yields the palindromic and nonpalindromic generating functions, and inspection of primitive third/fourth root poles gives exact period twelve; the order-three pole at one yields leading coefficient 1/24. The embedded verifier evaluates the recursive definition independently for all three-one words of length 3..37 and coefficients through 256. These checks corroborate an explicit all-length proof.
